items.context: Can you please confirm your account number?
items.text: haan ji

items.context: Do you want to block your card now?
items.text: abhi nahi

items.context: Was this transaction done by you?
items.text: nahi
mera account se paise kat gaye lekin maine transfer nahi kiya
woh transaction mujhe samajh nahi aaya
tum log check kar sakte ho kya transaction galat toh nahi hai
accha aap batayiye mera account safe hai na is time
umm matlab koi unauthorized payment hua hai jo maine nahi kiya
Tuesday nahi Wednesday ko mere account se do baar paise gaye the
haan ji mujhe rashi bhi batana hai jo kat gaye bina mera approval ke

items.context: Who did this transaction happen with?
items.text: sir paise kisne transfer kiya mujhe pata nahi hai
maine dekha ki transaction jagah Delhi batayi hai

items.context: Did you receive the transaction details on your phone?
items.text: Nahi sir mujhe transaction details clear nahi thi

items.context: Did you report this unauthorized transaction earlier?
items.text: Payment mera nahi tha uske baad maine turant bank ko call kiya

items.context: Was the transaction made by your card or net banking?
items.text: Kart se paise kate gaye hain magar maine pooja shopping nahi ki
Mere account se kal do baar unauthorized debit hua hai lekin maine kisi ko paise nahi diye hain
Transaction ki date 15th March hai aur amount 5000 hai jo maine kabhi transfer nahi kiya tha
Maine turant bank ko call kiya tha jab mujhe pata chala ki mera paisa kat gaya hai lekin solution nahi mila abhi tak

items.context: Can you describe the transactions you are talking about?
items.text: Jab maine apni account statement check ki toh mujhe do suspicious transactions mile the jo maine nahi kiye the isliye main report kar raha hoon

items.context: Did you authorize any transaction with OTP recently?
items.text: Maine apne registered mobile number par OTP bhi use nahi kiya tha lekin fir bhi unauthorized debit hua us din

items.context: Do you suspect any breach of your account information?
items.text: Mujhe lagta hai ki mera account hack ho gaya hai kyun ki mainne apni details kisi ko share nahi ki hai fir bhi paise nikal gaye hain

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: banking
Intent: unauthorised_debit - reports a transaction they did not make
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, matlab, woh, accha, haan ji); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, nahi, Wednesday')

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
